intuition.statement: Adaptive Discovery can ground its first semantic proposal in an immutable native retrieval without transferring search or action authority to the model.

hypothesis.statement: A run-owned Knowledge corpus and deterministic retrieval plan will make Discovery evidence reproducible while preserving typed semantic, controller, and executor boundaries.
falsifiable_predictions: The accepted semantic proposal will cite retrieved document identifiers that are present in the native retrieval artifact.
The controller will still select the fixed SEARCH, FORM_INTUITION, and FORM_WORKING_HYPOTHESIS actions.
Corpus, plan, execution-record, or state-reference tampering will fail independent project verification.

alternative_explanations: The auditability gain may arise mainly from immutable input copying rather than retrieval quality.
output_payload.uncertainty: This self-iteration validates evidence flow and recovery semantics, not comparative scientific-quality gains from retrieval.
